original.statement: The istiod-remote Helm chart has been removed; use helm install istio-discovery --set profile=remote instead.

exposure.needed: whether the environment installs Istio via the istiod-remote Helm chart (Helm release chart name), which no values-key or manifest predicate captures

corrected.statement: The istiod-remote Helm chart was removed in Istio 1.24.0 in favor of `helm install istio-discovery --set profile=remote`. Environments that install the istiod-remote chart are exposed. Static values cannot detect this, so exposure is undecidable.

decision.reason: [ev-274ce3859ab9] says a whole Helm chart (`istiod-remote`) was removed. It does not say a values key was removed. So the exposed environments are the ones that install that chart. The proposed values-key{path: istiod-remote, set} checks for a top-level values key that installs of the chart would not carry, so it would miss environments that really are exposed. None of the available condition types can detect which chart a Helm release was installed from, so the exposure is better stated as undecidable, naming the input that is missing.
